# Mnema
Mnema is a learning platform under active development. The current signed-in experience supports creating private decks and editing their title and description.

## Key Pages
- https://mnema.app/
- https://mnema.app/public-decks
- https://mnema.app/privacy
- https://mnema.app/terms

## Notes
- Private deck pages require a verified Mnema account.
- Study, editor, import, and public-catalog behavior is not part of the current own-deck flow.
